ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left side of the figure is a distribution map of soybean producing areas in the United States; the black areas indicate soybean producing areas, mainly concentrated in the central-eastern United States, with the 40°N latitude line marked beside it; these soybean areas are roughly located near 40°N and to its south, with a small number of areas to its north. On the right side is a distribution map of soybean producing areas in Brazil; the black areas are mainly distributed in central and southern Brazil, and the latitudinal position extends from low latitudes to near the Tropic of Capricorn and to the middle-latitude edge south of it. Reasoning: The soybean producing areas of the United States are roughly near 30°N–45°N, belonging to the low-latitude to middle-latitude range; the soybean producing areas of Brazil are also mainly located within the low-latitude and middle-latitude range. The soybean producing areas of the two countries are both not in high-latitude regions, so they are jointly located in middle and low latitudes.

method.method_draft: 读取题干可知需要比较美国和巴西大豆产区共同的纬度范围。先在图中找黑色的大豆产区，再借助美国图上40°N附近的纬线和巴西图中的水平纬线判断位置：美国大豆区大致在30°N—45°N附近，巴西大豆区大致在低纬到南回归线以南的中纬边缘。两国大豆产区都不是高纬地区，而是落在低纬和中纬范围内，因此回答“中、低纬度”。
